settings.info: Leave empty to use the store email.

settings.label: Announcement bar text
settings.info: Shown first in the moving notice bar. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Lines shown in the shop
settings.info: Comma separated: Men, Women, Kids. Products tagged with a line not listed here stay in Shopify but are hidden from the shop. A line with no products is hidden too.

settings.content: These numbers are what the shop shows. The real charge comes from Settings > Shipping and delivery and your discounts in the Shopify admin, so keep both the same.

settings.label: Free delivery on advance payment or a Care deposit
settings.info: Shows the offer in the top bar, the grey strip, policies and FAQ. Keep the free delivery code below active in Discounts.

settings.label: Care deposit by order total

Show low stock from this many pairs

settings.content: How the home page reads in Google results. Product and collection titles are set on each product and collection under Search engine listing.

settings.label: Home page title
settings.default: DAUR Supply | Men's Shoes & Leather Sneakers Online in Pakistan

settings.label: Home page description
settings.default: Shop men's leather sneakers, formal shoes, chelsea boots and casual slip ons from DAUR Supply, crafted in Pakistan. Cash on Delivery nationwide and free delivery on 2 pairs.

settings.label: Other official profiles
settings.info: One full address per line, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@daursupply. Add a profile only once it exists and is yours. Instagram and Facebook are already included. Search engines use this list to connect the profiles to the brand.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: Paste only the content value of the HTML tag Google gives you.

settings.label: Link preview image
settings.info: Shown when a page link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or Instagram and the page has no photo of its own. Best size 1200 x 630 px. Left empty, the built in DAUR share image is used. The Social sharing image in Online Store > Preferences takes priority over this.

settings.label: Microsoft Clarity project ID
settings.info: From clarity.microsoft.com, for example z6zmhh4wyo. Clarity records how visitors scroll and click; mention it in your privacy policy. Leave empty to turn it off.

settings.content: How prices are framed. Every figure shown comes from real prices in the store: nothing here invents a before price, a countdown or a stock level.

settings.label: Show the typical retail comparison
settings.info: Off by the owner's decision of 3 Nov 2026. When on, shows the struck through Typical retail figure (set under Store details) on cards, product pages, the Runway, the bag, the value flex card and stories. Pakistan's Competition Commission expects a struck through price to be a real price, so turn it on only if you can show that comparable pairs sell at that price.

settings.label: Show where a pair sits in the line
settings.info: On each product page: the pair with the next higher price, this pair and the next lower one, at their real prices, dearest first.

settings.label: Price per wear, days worn a week
settings.info: Shows 'About Rs. X a wear, worn N days a week for a year' under the price. Set 0 to hide it.

settings.label: Show the charity slice
settings.info: Shows the slice on product pages, in the bag, in the footer and on the Our giving page. Turn it off if the pledge is paused.

settings.label: Share of profit given (%)
settings.info: The pledge is at least 5% of profit, never of the price. Record each quarterly giving in Content > Metaobjects > Giving record; it appears on the Our giving page.

settings.label: Causes buyers can vote for
settings.default: School fees, Medical bills, Food rations
settings.info: Two to four causes, separated by commas. Buyers vote in the bag; the vote reaches each order as Slice cause. Change the list only between quarters.

settings.content: Real DAUR photographs for the home page and Our story. An empty slot falls back to a sample photo on a review theme, or to the drawn pair.

settings.label: Our story: the DAUR finish (laces, tag, seal, box)
Home: photo beside "Men's shoes, crafted in Pakistan."
Show sample photos (review themes only)
settings.info: Unsplash photos used to test layouts before real photos exist. They never show on the live theme, but switch this off before you publish.
